text: 老铺黄金：预计2026年上半年实现销售业绩（含税收入）约人民币227亿元至人民币233.5亿元，同比增长约60%至65%；非国际财务报告准则计量经调整净利润约人民币43.1亿元至人民币43.6亿元，同比增长约83%至85%。
text_en: Laopu Gold: Expects to achieve sales performance (including tax revenue) of approximately RMB 22.7 billion to RMB 23.35 billion for the first half of 2026, up about 60% to 65% year-on-year; adjusted net profit under non-IFRS measures of approximately RMB 4.31 billion to RMB 4.36 billion, up about 83% to 85% year-on-year.
